name: @pmndrs/ink-splat-video
description: Programmatic promo videos of the ink-splat UI: deterministic capture + a Remotion edit

scripts.ds:assets: mkdir -p public/design-system && for t in light dark; do ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i "../reference/design-system/r3f docs - $t.png" -vf scale=1080:-1:flags=lanczos public/design-system/$t.png; done
scripts.hero: remotion render remotion/index.ts Hero out/hero.raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/hero.raw.mp4 -map 0:v -map '0:a?' -c:v copy -af alimiter=limit=0.89:level=0 -c:a aac -b:a 256k out/hero.mp4
